info.name: BKSC Public API
info.description:
Ban Krut Sailing Club Public API - Complete collection with examples for banking, calendar, team, and equipment endpoints.

## Features
- Banking: Account summaries and detailed statements
- Calendar: Public events with filtering
- Team: Member contact information  
- Equipment: Categories and detailed equipment listings

## Rate Limits
- Standard endpoints: 30 requests/minute, 500 requests/hour
- Detail views: 20 requests/minute, 300 requests/hour
- Images: 60 requests/minute, 1000 requests/hour

## Usage
1. Set environment variables (base_url, lang)
2. Run requests in any order (no authentication required)
3. Check response examples for expected formats

item.name: Banking

request.description: Returns a list of publicly viewable bank accounts with their latest statement balances and total balance across all accounts.
Returns bank statements for a specific account by public slug (e.g., 'BANK', 'SAVINGS').

response.name: Success - Bank Statements

request.description: Returns detailed information for a specific bank statement including transaction lines.
